content: Use a retained, serializable annotation model (stroke/shape/text records) as the source of truth; render from it and maintain a separate transient preview during pointer gestures. Undo/redo is command or snapshot history over model mutations; fade timers mark visibility state and trigger dirty-region redraws, and empty overlays should be hidden. Export composes a native screen capture with the annotation scene in one coordinate system, excluding the overlay where the platform permits. Use one top-level overlay window per physical monitor for z-order, DPI, and full-screen reliability, with a shared store and monitor-local viewports.
